title: SoFi Stock News (Oct 15, 2026): SOFI Falls 6.7% to $14.22
summary: SOFI closed at $14.22 on Oct 14, down 6.69%, as a hot inflation report revived rate fears and hit fintech and financial stocks.
body_markdown:
## Why SoFi Stock Fell


According to[StockStory](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/sofi-bny-bread-financial-perella-190807063.html) , September consumer prices rose 3.7% year over year and core inflation topped estimates, which pushed traders' implied odds of a rate increase at the next Fed meeting to nearly 44%. Shares of BNY, Bread Financial, Perella Weinberg and Morgan Stanley also fell on October 14, and the same report noted that SoFi has had 32 moves greater than 5% over the past year.


As reported by[Motley Fool](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/stock-market-today-oct-14-215817008.html) , investors worried about near-term pressure because lending makes up a significant share of SoFi's revenue, and caution over how riskier fintechs fare in a high-rate environment weighed on the sector. Affirm also fell 9.74%, per the same report. No SoFi press release or filing on October 14 was found that addresses the move.


## SOFI Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Per[Simply Wall St.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/sofi-technologies-sofi-faces-inflation-201240125.html) , SoFi combines lending, financial services and a technology platform (Galileo and Technisys) that supplies infrastructure to other fintechs, giving it revenue beyond loans.
- The same source reports revenue of about $4.27 billion and net income of about $636 million, describing a shift from pure growth toward scalable profitability.
- StockStory reported that first-quarter revenue reached $1.1 billion, up 42.8% year over year.


### Risks


- Lending is rate-sensitive, and Motley Fool tied the drop to fears of higher interest rates after the inflation data.
- StockStory noted that weaker second-quarter guidance earlier this year sent the stock down 13.5%, showing how sharply shares react to outlook changes.
- The stock trades at $14.22, close to its new 52-week low of $13.92, after volume more than doubled its average.


SoFi's next earnings report is due on October 27, according to Motley Fool.
